posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
I decompiled probably my favorite game ever: Battlefield 1942 and I put it on the web with multiplayer for you to play here:

👉 https://t.co/6C8H8KtSaU 👈

(It's the free shareware demo)

It was way harder than the other ports like Quake and DOOM I did because they already had lots of open source projects and work behind them

In case of Battlefield 1942 there was literally absolutely nothing to work on top of, nobody had ever ported it and there was no open source engine for it, nor did the makers ever open source it (like id Software did with Quake 3)

I tried it 6 months ago and essentiay gave up but I tried it today again with Opus 5.5 asking "can you try port the BF1942 demo in this folder to web"

So me and Claude Code (well let's be honest mostly Claude Code) did crazy shit today:
- it disassembled the x86 raw machine code to find 57,000 x86 functions
- it translated each x86 function into a C function (mov eax, [esi+0x110] becomes eax = READ32(esi + 0x110), I have no idea what any of this means btw)
- it outputed 100,000 lines of C
- it then compiled that to WebAsswmbly with Emscripten
- there were 300x Windows and Direct3D functions used which we had to rewrite to WebGL 2 and OpenGL to work on the web
- then we had to build our own network stack so it could connect to our multiplayer server via WebSockets

I have no idea how it did any of this but it did it and it seems to work! 😊 

Come play and report any bugs here!
posts.quoted_text: I may or may have not just decompiled Battlefield 1942's raw C engine with Claude Code to run it in the browser 😬 https://t.co/CyTpryuDxo
posts.text_zh:
我大概反编译了我最爱的游戏之一：《Battlefield 1942》，并把它搬上了网页，还带多人联机，你可以在这里玩：

👉 https://t.co/6C8H8KtSaU 👈

（是免费的共享版 demo）

这比我以前移植 Quake、DOOM 难太多了，因为那些本来就有大量开源项目和前人成果可以站上去。

而对 Battlefield 1942，几乎是从零开始：从没人移植过，也没有开源引擎，制作方也从没开源过（不像 id Software 对 Quake 3 那样）。

我半年前试过，基本放弃了；今天又用 Opus 5.5 试了一遍，只问了一句：「能不能把这个文件夹里的 BF1942 demo 移植到网页」。

于是我和 Claude Code（老实说主要是 Claude Code）今天干了些疯狂的事：
- 反汇编 x86 机器码，找出约 57,000 个 x86 函数
- 把每个 x86 函数译成 C（比如 mov eax, [esi+0x110] 变成 eax = READ32(esi + 0x110)，我其实完全不懂这些）
- 输出了约 100,000 行 C
- 再用 Emscripten 编成 WebAssembly
- 大约有 300 个 Windows / Direct3D 函数要重写成 WebGL 2 和 OpenGL 才能上网页
- 还得自建网络栈，好让它通过 WebSockets 连上我们的多人服务器

我完全不知道它是怎么做到的，但它做到了，而且好像能玩！😊

来玩吧，有 bug 就在这里反馈！

posts.text:
My friend @stevelacey says AI agents almost never use MCPs if they have it available

I thought the same before which I was against MCP so long

I always thought APIs could do the same already, in the back they're almost exactly the same

Long term I think MCP and API endpoints will just merge into one, both supporting API keys and OAuth account level access

I have been adding MCPs to my site simply for the fact that people expect them now but as Steve says it's debatable if AI agents actually will use them over whatever other way there is to use your site
posts.quoted_text:

My setup is simple. Each agent is a Claude Code session with its own project folder and a .env containing whatever keys it needs. I tell it to get something done. I don’t care how.

It almost never picks MCP.

Not
posts.text_zh:
我朋友 @stevelacey 说：即便有 MCP，AI agent 也几乎从不用。

我以前也这么想，所以长期反对 MCP。

我一直觉得 API 本来就能做同样的事，底层几乎一样。

长期来看，我认为 MCP 和 API 端点会融成一种东西，同时支持 API key 和 OAuth 账号级访问。

我现在给站点加 MCP，主要是因为大家开始期待有它；但正如 Steve 所说，agent 到底会不会优先用 MCP，而不是用别的方式访问你的站点，其实很可疑。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
So @Ubuntu still hasn't patched this open hole on any Ubuntu server on the public internet that lets anyone take it over

We might just have to switch all our servers over to Debian in this new post-AGI time of rapid cybersecurity hacks which require just as rapid patching

Slowpokes will be left behind

https://t.co/9InAuqqqjT
posts.quoted_text:
This is why I said you want your VPS ports all closed

Then only let it be accessible inside your Tailscale for SSH and via a Cloudflare Tunnel to receive web traffic

Any Linux box can be taken over with just a single TCP port exposed to the internet now

A stop gap is disabling MPTCP on your VPS now but even better is not having any public ports exposed!
posts.text_zh:
所以 @Ubuntu 到现在还没给公网上任何一台 Ubuntu 服务器补上这个开放漏洞——谁都能直接接管机器。

在这个后 AGI、网络安全攻击和补丁都极速迭代的时代，我们可能只好把服务器全迁到 Debian 了。

动作慢的会被甩下。

https://t.co/9InAuqqqjT
posts.quoted_text_zh: 这就是为什么我说你的 VPS 端口要全部关掉。然后只让它在 Tailscale 内网里通过 SSH 访问，再通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 接收 Web 流量。现在任何一台 Linux 机器，只要有一个 TCP 端口暴露在公网上，就可能被完全接管。临时止血是禁用 MPTCP，更好是不要有任何公网端口。
posts.quoted_summary_zh: 引用他自己此前关于关掉 VPS 公网端口、改用 Tailscale + Cloudflare Tunnel 的安全建议帖。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
That's kind of the problem with X (or not)

It's a bad platform for sponsorships because (for me at least) it's about being as direct, transparent and honest as possible with your "audience"

Also it's not really an audience, it's more like a big internet forum I feel like where you can have cool discussions

The moment you take a sponsorship, the companies pay a lot of money for you to say something specific, that's probably not really what you believe in completely

Your followers immediately can sense that's not your own voice and cringe and very often unfollow, I mean I know I do for sure

But if it's a YouTube video it's kind of accepted "this video is sponsored by ACME, Inc.", nobody cares and it's just a few seconds in a 10 min video anyway so it's fine, it doesn't affect the content usually

That's hard to do on X because look at this tweet, it'd just be hard to fit in a sponsored message here that doesn't sound supercringe!
posts.quoted_text:
Paid engagement campaigns suffer from adverse selection because the most influential “influencers” can’t be bought

A tweet from someone like @levelsio or @GergelyOrosz would be worth paying any amount for,  and it’s because you can’t
posts.text_zh:
这大概就是 X 的问题所在（也可能不是问题）

它是个糟糕的赞助平台，因为（至少对我来说）在这里就是要对你的「受众」尽可能直接、透明、诚实。

而且它其实也不算是「受众」，我感觉更像一个巨大的网络论坛，大家可以在这里聊很酷的讨论。

一旦你接了赞助，公司花大价钱要你说特定的话——那往往并不是你完全真心相信的东西。

粉丝马上能感觉到那不是你的声音，会尴尬，而且经常取关；反正我自己肯定会。

但要是 YouTube 视频，大家基本接受「本视频由 ACME, Inc. 赞助」——没人在意，再说也就 10 分钟视频里几秒，通常不影响内容。

在 X 上很难这么做：你看这条推，塞进一条听起来不超级尴尬的赞助文案，几乎不可能！
posts.quoted_text_zh: 付费互动推广存在逆向选择问题：最有影响力的「网红」是买不到的。像 @levelsio 或 @GergelyOrosz 这样的人发一条推，花多少钱都值——正因为你买不到。
posts.quoted_summary_zh: 引用 @lulumeservey：付费推广有逆向选择问题，最有影响力的人（如 @levelsio、@GergelyOrosz）恰恰是花钱买不到的。

posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
If your website says "AI powered," you don't really understand copywriting or human desires.  

Truth is, no one wants AI powered products!

They want to look good in front of their boss. 
They want their problem gone. 
They want to be entertained. 
They want to feel smart for picking you. 
They want convenience.
posts.text_zh:
如果你的网站写着「AI powered」，你其实不太懂文案，也不懂人的欲望。

实话是：没人想要「AI 驱动」的产品！

他们想在老板面前好看。
他们想让问题消失。
他们想被娱乐。
他们想因为选了你而觉得自己很聪明。
他们想要便利。
